hydraulic-excavator.en: A hydraulic excavator uses its boom and bucket to dig material and load haul trucks.
hydraulic-excavator.sw: Excavator ya haidroliki hutumia mkono na ndoo yake kuchimba malighafi na kupakia malori.

wheel-loader.en: A wheel loader scoops loose material from stockpiles and loads it into trucks or feed hoppers.
wheel-loader.sw: Wheel loader huchota malighafi iliyolundikwa na kuipakia kwenye malori au hopper za kulishia mitambo.

dump-truck.en: A dump truck carries ore, waste rock and construction material in a tipping body.
dump-truck.sw: Lori la kutipa hubeba madini, mawe ya mabaki na vifaa vya ujenzi kwenye sehemu ya mizigo inayoinuliwa kumwaga.

bulldozer.en: A bulldozer pushes and spreads material with its front blade during site preparation and road work.
bulldozer.sw: Bulldozer husukuma na kusambaza malighafi kwa bapa lake la mbele wakati wa kuandaa eneo na kujenga barabara.

motor-grader.en: A motor grader shapes road surfaces and drainage slopes with an adjustable blade.
motor-grader.sw: Motor grader husawazisha barabara na kutengeneza mteremko wa kupitisha maji kwa bapa linalorekebishwa.

backhoe-loader.en: A backhoe loader combines a front loading bucket with a rear digging arm for trenching and site work.
backhoe-loader.sw: Backhoe loader ina ndoo ya kupakia mbele na mkono wa kuchimba nyuma kwa mitaro na kazi za eneo.

vibratory-roller.en: A vibratory roller compacts road and foundation material through drum weight and vibration.
vibratory-roller.sw: Rola ya mtetemo hushindilia malighafi ya barabara na misingi kwa uzito na mtetemo wa ngoma yake.

tower-crane.en: A tower crane lifts construction loads along its jib, with lifting capacity depending on the load radius.
tower-crane.sw: Kreni ya mnara huinua mizigo ya ujenzi kwa mkono wake, huku uwezo wa kuinua ukitegemea umbali wa mzigo kutoka kwenye mnara.

concrete-mixer.en: A concrete mixer truck keeps concrete mixed in a rotating drum while transporting it to the work site.
concrete-mixer.sw: Lori la kuchanganya zege huzungusha ngoma yake ili zege liendelee kuchanganyika wakati wa kusafirishwa eneo la kazi.

cone-crusher.en: A cone crusher reduces rock between a moving cone and a fixed liner, commonly after primary crushing.
cone-crusher.sw: Cone crusher hupunguza ukubwa wa mawe kati ya koni inayosogea na liner iliyotulia, kwa kawaida baada ya hatua ya kwanza ya kuponda.

hammer-mill.en: A hammer mill breaks material with rotating hammers and controls the discharge size through a screen.
hammer-mill.sw: Hammer mill huvunja malighafi kwa nyundo zinazozunguka na kudhibiti ukubwa unaotoka kupitia kichujio.

wet-pan-mill.en: A wet pan mill grinds ore with heavy rollers moving around a pan containing water and feed material.
wet-pan-mill.sw: Wet pan mill husaga madini kwa rola nzito zinazozunguka ndani ya beseni lenye maji na malighafi.

vibrating-screen.en: A vibrating screen separates material into size fractions as it moves across screened decks.
vibrating-screen.sw: Kichujio cha mtetemo hutenganisha malighafi kwa ukubwa inapopita juu ya tabaka zenye matundu ya kuchuja.

trommel-screen.en: A trommel screen separates gravel by size as material passes through a rotating perforated drum.
trommel-screen.sw: Trommel hutenganisha changarawe kwa ukubwa wakati malighafi inapita ndani ya ngoma inayozunguka yenye matundu.

belt-conveyor.en: A belt conveyor moves material between crushers, screens, stockpiles and other stages of a processing plant.
belt-conveyor.sw: Conveyor ya mkanda husafirisha malighafi kati ya mashine za kuponda, vichujio, malundo na hatua nyingine za mtambo.

hydrocyclone.en: A hydrocyclone classifies particles in slurry, separating a finer overflow from a coarser underflow.
hydrocyclone.sw: Hydrocyclone hutenganisha chembe kwenye tope, ikitoa chembe laini juu na kundi kubwa zaidi chini.

filter-press.en: A filter press removes water from slurry through filter cloths, leaving solids as a filter cake.
filter-press.sw: Filter press huondoa maji kwenye tope kupitia vitambaa vya kuchuja na kuacha yabisi kama keki ya uchujaji.

vibrating-feeder.en: A vibrating feeder delivers material from a hopper to a crusher at a controlled feed rate.
vibrating-feeder.sw: Feeder ya mtetemo hupeleka malighafi kutoka hopper hadi mashine ya kuponda kwa kiwango kinachodhibitiwa.

pneumatic-rock-drill.en: A pneumatic jackleg drill uses compressed air to drill rock, supported by an adjustable pusher leg.
pneumatic-rock-drill.sw: Jackleg hutumia hewa iliyobanwa kuchimba mawe, huku mguu wake unaorekebishwa ukiishikilia na kuisukuma.

lighting-tower.en: A lighting tower raises floodlights above the work area to illuminate night operations.
lighting-tower.sw: Mnara wa taa huinua taa juu ya eneo la kazi ili kuangaza shughuli za usiku.

rotary-scrubber.en: A rotary scrubber washes gravel in a rotating drum to break up clay before screening and recovery.
rotary-scrubber.sw: Rotary scrubber huosha changarawe ndani ya ngoma inayozunguka ili kuvunja udongo kabla ya kuchuja na kutenganisha dhahabu.

sluice-box-gold-jig.en: Sluices and jigs separate heavier gold particles from washed gravel using water flow and gravity.
sluice-box-gold-jig.sw: Sluice na jig hutenganisha chembe nzito za dhahabu kutoka changarawe iliyooshwa kwa mtiririko wa maji na tofauti za uzito.

alluvial-gold-wash-plant.en: An alluvial gold wash plant combines washing, screening and gravity separation to process gold-bearing gravel.
alluvial-gold-wash-plant.sw: Mtambo wa dhahabu ya alluvial huunganisha kuosha, kuchuja na kutenganisha kwa tofauti za uzito ili kuchakata changarawe yenye dhahabu.

1-ton-winch.en: A 1 tonne electric winch winds wire rope onto a powered drum to pull material and equipment.
1-ton-winch.sw: Winchi ya umeme ya tani 1 hukusanya waya kwenye ngoma yenye mota ili kuvuta malighafi na vifaa.

2-ton-winch.en: A 2 tonne electric winch uses a motor-driven drum and wire rope for material handling.
2-ton-winch.sw: Winchi ya umeme ya tani 2 hutumia ngoma inayoendeshwa na mota pamoja na waya kusogeza mizigo.

5-ton-mine-winch.en: A 5 tonne mine winch uses a powered drum, wire rope and braking system to handle mining loads.
5-ton-mine-winch.sw: Winchi ya mgodini ya tani 5 hutumia ngoma yenye mota, waya na mfumo wa breki kushughulikia mizigo ya uchimbaji.

mine-hoist-headframe.en: A mine hoist and headframe guide and control the rope used to move loads through a shaft.
mine-hoist-headframe.sw: Hoist na mnara wa shimo huongoza na kudhibiti waya unaotumika kupandisha na kushusha mizigo shimoni.

wire-rope-slings-lifting-tackle.en: Wire ropes, slings and lifting tackle connect a load to the lifting equipment for its planned duty.
wire-rope-slings-lifting-tackle.sw: Waya, mikanda ya kuinulia na viungio huunganisha mzigo na kifaa cha kuinua kulingana na kazi iliyopangwa.

centrifugal-gold-concentrator.en: A centrifugal gold concentrator uses a spinning bowl and water to separate heavy gold particles from slurry.
centrifugal-gold-concentrator.sw: Concentrator ya centrifugal hutumia bakuli linalozunguka na maji kutenganisha chembe nzito za dhahabu kutoka kwenye tope.

gold-elution-electrowinning-plant.en: An elution and electrowinning plant removes gold from loaded carbon and recovers it from solution onto electrodes.
gold-elution-electrowinning-plant.sw: Mtambo wa elution na electrowinning huondoa dhahabu kwenye kaboni iliyoibeba na kuikusanya kutoka kwenye myeyusho kwenye elektrodi.

cil-cip-plant.en: CIL and CIP plants use leaching tanks and activated carbon to dissolve gold and collect it for recovery.
cil-cip-plant.sw: Mitambo ya CIL na CIP hutumia matanki ya leaching na kaboni iliyoamilishwa kuyeyusha dhahabu na kuikusanya kwa hatua ya kuitoa.

leaching-tank.en: An agitated leaching tank keeps slurry and reagents mixed during the gold-dissolution stage.
leaching-tank.sw: Tanki la leaching lenye kichanganyio huweka tope na kemikali zikichanganyika wakati wa kuyeyusha dhahabu.

modular-gold-plant.en: A modular gold plant groups processing equipment into sections that can be transported and assembled on site.
modular-gold-plant.sw: Mtambo wa dhahabu wa moduli huweka vifaa vya kuchakata katika sehemu zinazoweza kusafirishwa na kuunganishwa eneo la kazi.

ball-mill-gold-ore.en: A ball mill grinds crushed ore in a rotating drum containing steel grinding balls.
ball-mill-gold-ore.sw: Ball mill husaga madini yaliyopondwa ndani ya ngoma inayozunguka yenye mipira ya chuma ya kusagia.

jaw-crusher.en: A jaw crusher breaks large rock between a fixed jaw and a moving jaw before further processing.
jaw-crusher.sw: Jaw crusher huvunja mawe makubwa kati ya taya iliyotulia na taya inayosogea kabla ya hatua nyingine za kuchakata.

shaking-table-gold.en: A gold shaking table separates heavy particles on a moving deck using water flow and gravity.
shaking-table-gold.sw: Meza ya kutenganisha dhahabu hutenganisha chembe nzito kwenye uso unaosogea kwa mtiririko wa maji na tofauti za uzito.

rc-drilling-rig.en: An RC drilling rig uses compressed air and dual-wall drill rods to bring rock-chip samples to the surface.
rc-drilling-rig.sw: Rig ya RC hutumia hewa iliyobanwa na mabomba yenye njia mbili kuleta sampuli za vipande vya mawe juu ya ardhi.

gold-metal-detector.en: A gold prospecting metal detector uses a search coil to locate metal targets in the ground.
gold-metal-detector.sw: Kigunduzi cha metali cha kutafuta dhahabu hutumia koili kutambua metali iliyo ardhini.

slurry-pump.en: A slurry pump transfers water containing solid particles between stages of a processing plant.
slurry-pump.sw: Pampu ya tope husafirisha maji yenye chembe za yabisi kati ya hatua za mtambo wa kuchakata.

submersible-dewatering-pump.en: A submersible dewatering pump operates below the water surface to drain sumps, shafts and work areas.
submersible-dewatering-pump.sw: Pampu ya kuzamishwa hufanya kazi chini ya maji kuyatoa kwenye mashimo ya kukusanyia, mashimo ya uchimbaji na maeneo ya kazi.

mining-safety-helmet-cap-lamp.en: A mining helmet with a cap lamp combines head protection with lighting for underground work.
mining-safety-helmet-cap-lamp.sw: Kofia ya usalama yenye taa huunganisha kinga ya kichwa na mwanga kwa kazi chini ya ardhi.

self-contained-self-rescuer.en: A self-contained self-rescuer provides a breathing supply for emergency escape from an unsafe atmosphere.
self-contained-self-rescuer.sw: Kifaa cha kujinusuru cha SCSR hutoa hewa ya kupumua kwa kuondoka kwa dharura kwenye mazingira yenye hewa isiyo salama.

gas-detection-monitor.en: A multi-gas monitor measures selected gases and oxygen levels when assessing mine or confined-space conditions.
gas-detection-monitor.sw: Kipima gesi nyingi hupima gesi zilizochaguliwa na kiwango cha oksijeni wakati wa kutathmini hali ya mgodi au sehemu iliyofungwa.

fall-arrest-harness.en: A full-body harness connects a worker to an appropriate fall-protection system when working at height.
fall-arrest-harness.sw: Harness ya mwili mzima humuunganisha mfanyakazi na mfumo unaofaa wa kujikinga na kuanguka anapofanya kazi sehemu ya juu.

mine-ventilation-fan.en: A mine ventilation fan moves air through ducts or mine passages to support underground ventilation.
mine-ventilation-fan.sw: Feni ya mgodini husukuma hewa kupitia mabomba au njia za mgodi kusaidia uingizaji na utoaji wa hewa chini ya ardhi.

mine-management-software.en: Mine management software brings production, shift and operating records together for planning and reporting.
mine-management-software.sw: Programu ya usimamizi wa mgodi hukusanya taarifa za uzalishaji, zamu na uendeshaji kwa kupanga kazi na kutoa ripoti.

fleet-management-system.en: A fleet management system tracks vehicle movements and operating records to help manage haulage.
fleet-management-system.sw: Mfumo wa usimamizi wa magari hufuatilia mienendo na taarifa za uendeshaji ili kusaidia kusimamia usafirishaji wa mizigo.

geological-modelling-software.en: Geological modelling software organises exploration data and builds models of geological structures and mineralisation.
geological-modelling-software.sw: Programu ya uundaji wa modeli za jiolojia hupanga data za utafiti na kuunda modeli za miundo ya ardhi na madini.

diesel-generator-mining.en: A diesel generator combines a diesel engine and an alternator to supply electrical power to mining equipment.
diesel-generator-mining.sw: Jenereta ya dizeli huunganisha injini ya dizeli na alternator kuzalisha umeme kwa vifaa vya uchimbaji.

air-compressor-mining.en: A mining air compressor supplies compressed air for pneumatic drills and other air-powered equipment.
air-compressor-mining.sw: Compressor ya mgodini hutoa hewa iliyobanwa kwa mashine za kuchimba na vifaa vingine vinavyoendeshwa kwa hewa.
